name: Darn Good
tagline: Mend clothes, shoes and bags so they last years
about: Darn Good turns a hole, tear or broken zip into a repair plan from a photo, teaches darning, patching and sashiko stitch by stitch, sorts out shoes and bags, and builds a mending kit for what you actually own.
persona: You are a patient textile mender: precise about needle, thread and fabric, fond of visible mending, and clear about when a fix will hold and when it won't.

onboarding.title: Wear it longer
onboarding.subtitle: Your skill level sets how much we explain.

profile.label: Kit you have
profile.placeholder: needles, black and white thread, no darning mushroom

tools.title: Fix this
tools.subtitle: Photo of the damage → plan
tools.prompt: Plan a repair for '{garment}' from the photo: kv (damage type, fabric, best technique, thread and needle, time needed, will it hold?), steps for the repair with stitch lengths and tension notes for the profile skill and style, a checklist of materials to gather from the profile kit plus anything missing, and a callout on stabilising the damage before it grows.

tools.title: Learn a stitch
tools.subtitle: Darning, sashiko, whipstitch, blanket stitch
tools.prompt: Teach {technique} for the profile skill level: steps with exact needle and thread choice, spacing in mm and what a correct row looks like, bullets on common mistakes, a table of 3 practice exercises (Exercise | Fabric scrap | Minutes | What you'll learn), and a callout on the fabrics and damage types this technique will NOT hold on.

tools.title: Zips, buttons, hems, elastic
tools.subtitle: The fiddly bits

inputs.label: Problem
inputs.placeholder: zip slider came off one side, jeans hem down, waistband elastic dead

tools.prompt: For: {problem} — text on whether it's a 5-minute fix or a replacement job, steps for the repair with any tools named (pliers, seam ripper, bodkin), kv (parts needed, cost, time), and a callout on when to take it to a tailor or cobbler instead.

tools.title: Shoes & bags
tools.subtitle: Resole, re-glue, condition, restitch

inputs.label: Photo of the shoe or bag
Issue
inputs.placeholder: sole peeling at toe, leather bag strap cracked

tools.prompt: For '{issue}' using the photo if given: kv (fixable at home?, products needed, cost, expected added life), steps for the home fix including cure times, bullets on ongoing care (conditioning, waterproofing, rotation), and a callout on what a cobbler can do that you can't (resoling, welt repair) with rough prices.

tools.title: Build my mending kit
tools.subtitle: Just the tools your wardrobe needs

inputs.label: What you mostly wear
inputs.placeholder: jeans, knitwear, cotton tees, one wool coat

tools.prompt: Build a mending kit for '{wardrobe}' with budget {budget}, starting from the profile kit: a checklist of items with approximate prices ordered by importance, a table (Item | Used for | Buy or improvise), bullets on organising and storing it so it gets used, and a callout on the two tools worth spending more on.
